**Review of the peppermint product page copy**

- **"Peppermint. Just peppermint leaves, nothing else."** This is an ingredient fact, which the policy allows as written.
- **"Cool and clean after a big meal."** This describes how the tea tastes and feels, not an effect on the body. It doesn't say the tea aids digestion, settles the stomach or relieves anything, so I don't read it as a health claim. If it were reworded to something like "aids digestion" or "settles your stomach", it would become one.
- **"Certified organic by the Soil Association."** This is on the approved claims list.
- **Labels and disclosure:** This is the brand's own product page, so no ad label is needed. There is no price, offer, urgency, guarantee, review figure or comparison to check.
- **Style:** The copy is short and specific, with none of the listed clichés or filler.

Nothing needs changing, so it can go out.
